analysis: Cardiomyopathy, particularly a form known as Keshan disease, has been associated with selenium deficiency. Selenium is an essential trace element that plays a critical role in the antioxidant defense system and thyroid hormone metabolism. Deficiency in selenium can lead to oxidative stress and damage to cardiac tissue, contributing to the development of cardiomyopathy.
